create_racecar_gym_env: create a RacecarGymEnv instance with discrete actions and rendering enabled for a PyBullet gym environment
reset_racecar_simulation: reset the RacecarGymEnv simulation to load the stadium, place a ball, and spawn the racecar
step_racecar_action: step the RacecarGymEnv with a discrete or continuous action to move the racecar toward the ball
get_extended_observation: get the extended observation returning the ball position relative to the racecar frame
render_racecar_rgb: render the RacecarGymEnv as an RGB array using a camera tracking the racecar position
